subject.title: dotenv loader does not expand env references in .env files

question: Which dotenv sources, if any, should expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` references, and what should OpenClaw do when a referenced value is missing or blocked?
rationale: The code change is mechanically bounded, but it changes credential propagation and trust boundaries across lower-trust workspace files, trusted state-dir files, provider auth variables, and durable service env generation.

options.title: Approve Scoped Expansion
options.body: Expand references only after source-specific blocklists and precedence are applied, define missing-reference behavior, and add regression coverage for workspace/global/provider/service-env cases.

options.title: Keep Dotenv Literal
options.body: Document `.env` loading as literal and direct users to config `${VAR}` substitution, SecretRefs, or shell import for aliasing.

options.title: Defer To Secret UX
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for the broader env-backed SecretRef/source policy before changing dotenv semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Expansion
recommendation.body: Expand references only after source-specific blocklists and precedence are applied, define missing-reference behavior, and add regression coverage for workspace/global/provider/service-env cases.
